_status: THE INDEPENDENT WATCHDOG. AUTHENTICATED CANCEL-ONLY since the owner's 2026-10-18 approval, which reversed the credential-free rule of 2026-10-14: the image now carries src/pmus_auth.py and can sign exactly one mutating route, POST /v1/order/{id}/cancel. The isolation is route-based rather than credential-absence -- CancelOnlyTransport refuses every other method and route, no submit-capable module is in the image, and a cancel additionally requires L5_WATCHDOG_CANCEL=YES, a FRESH ownership claim from the executor's registry, and the venue's own row reporting AUTOMATIC on the same market. It can assert the halt latch and never clear it. WATCH PATTERN IS A SAFETY PROPERTY, NOT A BUILD PREFERENCE: with no watchPatterns this service redeployed on EVERY push to the branch, which on 2026-10-15T12:13:04Z restarted it in the same second as the executor (executor 4f3d3df6, watchdog ce8e2b6e, both commit 669fb3ac) and left a gap with nothing watching. A supervisor that restarts whenever the supervised process does is not independent. It now deploys only when DEPLOY_TRIGGER changes, exactly as the executor does.
